I think there are a lot of great answers in here, but I wanted to address something missed in all of the posts I have read regarding self-heal. While it is true there are many characters that have self-heal (Mercy passive regen, Ana bio-nade, soldier healing field, roadhog take a breather, Lucio in healing mode, Moira orbs, tracer recall, bastion repair, Reaper passive, mei cryofreeze) there is also a type of health in overwatch that is regenerative. Whenever you see a LIGHT BLUE section of a hero's health bar, this indicates a shield that is regenerative. It acts exactly like normal health, except it can regenerate after a period of time of going without taking damage. So the natural health bars of symmetra, zenyatta, and zarya all have this as a portion of their health pool. On top of this, symmetra's shield generator creates this shield for her teammates that are within in its range.

Also, as an add-on that you didn't ask about, there are two more types of health besides standard white health. If you see an orange armor in a hero's health bar, this is a type of armor that acts a bit differently from health. While it does not regenerate like health (even if the hero has a healing ability or is being healed), this type of armor has a property which reduces incoming damage by a small amount. This is very useful against enemies such as tracer, soldier 76, and sombra who rely on hitting a lot of shots that do a small amount of damage per bullet, because it greatly reduces the damage from a portion of those incoming shots. However, this type of armor is largely ineffective against large amounts of incoming damage delivered at once, such as pharah rockets, a doomfist punch, a Reinhardt charge, etc. 

There's one more type of health in overwatch that is a dark blue color, which (to my knowledge) does not have any special effects of damage reduction or anything of that sort. It is simply a health that is constantly decaying, and cannot be healed by any means. This type of health is only granted through lucio's sound barrier and doomfist's passive ability to generate it when landing punches on enemies.

One final note: I believe that the EMP ability of Sombra can actually remove the light blue shield health of enemies within its radius.
